title: Implement necking bar benchmark with 2% load-displacement comparison
objective: Replace the placeholder necking bar test with a production-quality benchmark using the imperfection mesh and reference data, achieving 2% load-displacement curve agreement. This is the MVP acceptance criterion.

plan_assets.asset_description: Necking bar benchmark specification with material params and tolerance

scope: Replace necking_bar_problem fixture with production setup
Material: J2 power-law with necking-appropriate parameters
implementation_steps: Replace necking_bar_problem fixture with production mesh and material
Implement load-displacement curve extraction at each converged step
Interpolate computed curve onto reference displacement points
Assert relative error < 2% at all load levels
deliverables: Updated TestNeckingBar with production mesh and material
acceptance_criteria: Load-displacement curve within 2% of reference at all load levels
Newton converges at all 20 load steps
risks: Newton may not converge at large deformations near necking onset. Mitigation: use 20+ load steps with adaptive stepping.
2% tolerance may be tight for coarse mesh. Mitigation: match reference mesh resolution or use interpolation.
completion_notes: Benchmark implementation was already present on commit 59893b6 and was reconciled into tracker state after a fresh verification run on 2026-04-12.
